_about: Hand decisions for MCC college names the handoff could not match (2026-10-20). 'pattern' is a run of the name's letters only (uppercase, no spaces, digits or punctuation), so MCC's spacing variants of one college share a decision; 'state' (optional) must match the row's state; 'kind' is mdms (MD/MS/Diploma/M.Ch. rows), dnb (DNB and NBE diploma rows) or any; 'id' is our PG institute (null = none of ours). Our PG data lists many colleges twice — the MD/MS entry under MCC's name and a DNB entry under NBEMS's name with a PIN code — hence the split kinds. Applied by scripts/import_mcc_handoff.ts, which prints every name each pattern caught.
